title: vuln-autofix services config
description: Schema for services-config.yaml and for the per-service fragment analytics-api serves. The predecessor had no schema at all, so a typo'd key (dockerfile_path -> dockerfilepath) failed mid-run, after the Docker build had already been paid for. Two fields that 9 and 3 services actually rely on (vendor_for_docker, docker_build_context) were undocumented.

harbor_registry.description: Registry logged into before the image build.

services.description: Keyed by service name, which is what the workflow passes as service_name.

team.description: Owning team. Becomes the PR label team:<value> so PRs land in the right queue. Not read by any script.

image_name.description: Local tag for the scanned image (built as <image_name>:scan).

dockerfile_path.description: Dockerfile, relative to working_directory. Existence is checked before the build.

server_build_path.description: Single main package to build, e.g. ./cmd/cloud, or "." / "./" when main is at the module root (4 of the 105 registered services do this). Must resolve to ONE main package — ./... will not work.

base_image.description: Passed as --build-arg BASE_IMAGE. Validated against Harbor by the registration wizard.

docker_build_extra_args.description: Interpolated unquoted into docker build. Keep it to --build-arg pairs.

go_private.description: GOPRIVATE/GONOSUMDB globs, e.g. github.com/Infoblox-CTO/*. Without this, private imports resolve through the public proxy and 404.

vendor_for_docker.description: Run go mod vendor on the host before docker build. Needed when the Dockerfile compiles in-container and so cannot reach private modules itself.

docker_build_context.description: docker build context. Set to .. for a monorepo module whose Dockerfile COPYs from the repo root.

working_directory.description: Module subdirectory for multi-module repos. Also passed to the workflow.

mode.description: DEPRECATED, ignored. Only ever accepted the value 'heuristic'.

min_confidence.description: DEPRECATED, ignored. Could never bind: confidence was a constant above it.

confidence.description: DEPRECATED, ignored. Was a config constant, never computed.

policy.description: What may be applied without a human. Replaces the weighted risk score, which could not discriminate: at the shipped weights every finding scored auto_apply.

auto_apply.description: Bump types eligible for automatic application. major is deliberately not an option.

max_minor_jump.description: Largest minor-version delta still applied automatically. Beyond this it goes to review.

never.description: Never automatic. stdlib findings need a Go toolchain bump, not a module edit.

require_build_pass.description: Roll back and fail rather than open a PR that does not compile.
